# JobList.am - Armenia's Job Marketplace

## Overview

JobList.am is Armenia's premier two-sided job marketplace connecting talented professionals with top employers. Our platform offers comprehensive tools for both job seekers and employers to streamline the hiring process.

## Key Features

### For Job Seekers
- Browse and search thousands of job listings
- Apply to jobs with ease
- Track application status in real-time
- Save favorite job listings
- Build and manage professional profiles
- Get notified of new opportunities

### For Employers
- Post job openings
- Manage applications efficiently
- Review candidate profiles
- Track hiring pipeline
- Connect with qualified candidates

## Platform Information

- **Location**: Armenia
- **Type**: Job Marketplace Platform
- **Target Audience**: Professionals and Employers in Armenia
- **Main URL**: https://joblist-am.vercel.app

## Important Links

> Homepage: https://joblist-am.vercel.app
> Browse Jobs: https://joblist-am.vercel.app/all-jobs
> Register: https://joblist-am.vercel.app/register

## Contact

For inquiries about the platform, please visit our website at https://joblist-am.vercel.app

## Technology Stack

Built with React, Redux Toolkit, Styled Components, and Supabase for a modern, responsive user experience.
